name: Vale of White Horse Local Plan 2031: Part One - Strategic Sites and Policies
organisation-name: Vale of White Horse District Council

housing-numbers.organisation-name: Vale of White Horse District Council
housing-numbers.notes: Housing requirement is 'at least 20,560' for 2011-2031. Strategic allocations total 12,495 across three sub-areas. Annual requirement of 1,028 per annum mentioned on page 24. Local Plan Part 2 allocations of 1,000 are for sites to be identified in future plan. Does not include Oxford's unmet housing need which will be addressed in Part 2.
